name: ASM-025 indexing turntable fixture assembly benchmark
description: Intermediate hierarchical CAD assembly benchmark for a small indexing turntable fixture with a round base, rotating disk, repeated index pins, clamps, jaws, screws, and support feet.

tasks.prompt: Create an indexing table / turntable fixture assembly with a round base, rotating disk, center bearing, repeated index pins around the table, four fixture clamp blocks with screws and jaws, and support feet. Keep geometry robust and visually recognizable.
assumptions: Index pins, fixture clamps, jaws, clamp screws, and feet are modeled as repeated functional occurrences.
Clamp screw orientation is simplified to a common axis; the layout still communicates an indexing fixture without fragile rotated transforms.
Generated STEP, GLB, and topology artifacts are benchmark outputs, not source files.
